codex.remnants.prologue.text: Here the dead do not stay down. Whatever you carried rises with your echo, and waits. These pages teach how to win it back, and what lies beyond.
codex.remnants.filler.0: What you lose is never lost. It waits, wearing your face.
codex.remnants.filler.1: Every echo fades in the end - but only by your hand.
codex.remnants.filler.2: The King gathers what the living forget.
codex.remnants.filler.3: Each soul laid to rest leaves a little of itself in you.
codex.remnants.death.1.title: When You Die
codex.remnants.death.1.text:
Nothing falls to the ground. Your §binventory§r and §ball your experience§r rise as a §bRemnant§r: an echo of you in copies of your gear.

It §bkneels where you fell§r and waits until you come within 9 blocks or strike it - so you choose when the fight starts. You respawn with a §bSpectral Compass§r that points to it.

Defeat it and everything comes straight back into your inventory, armor on, levels restored.
codex.remnants.death.ghost.title: Your Echo
codex.remnants.death.ghost.text: It wears your skin and your gear - but the gear is §bhollow§r: a fresh kit is enough to win.
codex.remnants.death.2.title: Streaks and Crowns
codex.remnants.death.2.text:
Die again before reclaiming and the next Remnant is tougher: §6+15% health, +7.5% damage§r per death in a row, up to four times. Reclaiming resets the streak.

One Remnant in ten is §bEmpowered§r: it seizes your weapon and charges it - defeat it and you win a §bSpectral§r version (+1 to every enchantment) and a §bRemnant Crown§r.

Remnants never despawn and ignore lava, fire, explosions and the void.
codex.remnants.death.3.title: Rules of the Dead
codex.remnants.death.3.text:
With the keepInventory rule on, nothing happens. A §bTotem of Undying§r still saves you. Items with Curse of Vanishing still vanish.

If another player lays your Remnant to rest, your items drop as protected items that never despawn.

This §bCodex§r is soul-bound: it is always in your pocket after death.
codex.remnants.battle.1.title: Read the Fight
codex.remnants.battle.1.text:
Every move is announced.

• §bWeapon drawn back§r - a strike lands in a moment: step back, or raise your shield.
• §bRing of soul fire§r closing in - a nova: jump over the wave.
• §bCircle on the ground§r - something falls there: leave it.
• §bA chain forming§r - break line of sight before it snaps.
codex.remnants.battle.2.title: Poise and Parry
codex.remnants.battle.2.text:
Under its health bar is a white §bPoise§r bar. Every hit wears it down - falling (critical) blows and axes more. When it breaks, the Remnant is §bstaggered§r: stunned for 2.5 s and taking §6+50% damage§r.

Raise your shield §bjust before§r a strike lands for a §bperfect parry§r: the blow glances off and its poise cracks.

Poise recovers if you back off. After a stagger the bar turns yellow - immune for a few seconds.
codex.remnants.battle.3.title: Breathers and Phases
codex.remnants.battle.3.text:
After a big move the Remnant stands §bcatching its breath§r (soul wisps over its head): free hits.

At §660%§r health it roars into §bWrath§r: a shockwave and two §bechoes§r. Echoes pop in one hit and hit softly - find the real one.
At §625%§r comes §bDespair§r: faster, and it drinks a little life with each blow.

Out of combat it heals, but §bnever past the phase it reached§r: you can retreat, eat and come back.
codex.remnants.battle.4.title: Weapon by Weapon
codex.remnants.battle.4.text:
Its fighting style is the weapon you died holding.

• §bSword§r: three-hit combos, a lunge.
• §bAxe§r: a wide cleave that breaks shields, a leap.
• §bMace§r: a sky slam (it is stunned after), wind blasts.
• §bTrident§r: thrown spears, marked lightning.
• §bBow / crossbow§r: volleys, an aimed heavy shot, arrow rain.
• §bBare hands / tools§r: an uppercut.

The ghost gear keeps only §635%§r of its armor (no enchantments) and its weapon deals §640%§r of the real damage.
codex.remnants.battle.5.title: Before You Go
codex.remnants.battle.5.text:
• An iron sword and a shield are enough.
• Facing a shield? Bring an §baxe§r: it breaks the guard and stuns.
• Food or a golden apple.
• Fight it on your own terms: a §bSoul Anchor§r decides where it rises.
• A §bSoul Ward§r in your pocket weakens the next one.
• From rank I on the Path of the Soul you return hungry for vengeance.
codex.remnants.fragments.1.title: Where Souls Gather
codex.remnants.fragments.1.text:
§bSoul Fragments§r are the currency of the dead.

• §bForgotten Remnants§r: 1-3 each.
• §bForgotten Graves§r: usually 1-3 in the casket.
• §bWither Skeletons§r (killed by you): 8%, +2% per Looting.
• §bYour own Remnants§r: 60% for 1-2 (more on a streak); Empowered ones 3-5.
• §bThe Soul King§r: 8-12.

Eight fragments make a §bCondensed Soul§r - the fuel of every relic.
codex.remnants.fragments.forgotten.title: The Forgotten
codex.remnants.fragments.forgotten.text: Echoes of adventurers dead for ages. They walk the overworld at night and haunt the Soul Sand Valley. One in twenty is Crowned and keeps a Remnant Crown.
codex.remnants.fragments.condensed.title: Condensed Soul
codex.remnants.fragments.condensed.text: Eight fragments pressed into one. It can be broken back into eight.
codex.remnants.fragments.bricks.title: Soul Bricks
codex.remnants.fragments.bricks.text: One fragment lights eight blackstone bricks. Stairs, slabs, walls and chiseled bricks follow, also on the stonecutter.
codex.remnants.fragments.brazier.title: Soul Brazier
codex.remnants.fragments.brazier.text: A gold-clawed bowl of soul fire. Full light.
codex.remnants.relics.compass.title: Spectral Compass
codex.remnants.relics.compass.text: Its needle points to your nearest Remnant. Right-click for distance, height and tier. You get one on respawn anyway.
codex.remnants.relics.ward.title: Soul Ward
codex.remnants.relics.ward.text: Carry it: on death it burns away and your Remnant rises weakened - no streak, 40% less health, never Empowered.
codex.remnants.relics.anchor.title: Soul Anchor
codex.remnants.relics.anchor.text: Feed it a Condensed Soul (up to 3 charges): your next Remnant rises here, not where you fell - in the same dimension.
codex.remnants.relics.forge.title: Soul Forge
codex.remnants.relics.forge.text: Use it with a weapon in hand: +1 Spectral level for 2 / 4 Condensed Souls. The third level is forged in the Soul Crucible (chapter "Craft"). Full repair.
codex.remnants.relics.phylactery.title: Phylactery
codex.remnants.relics.phylactery.text: Made with the Soul King's Heart. Three times, your whole inventory waits for you on the other side - no Remnant rises.
codex.remnants.king.1.title: The Summoning Circle
codex.remnants.king.1.text:
Place a §bSpirit Offering Table§r and four §bSoul Pedestals§r in a cross, 5 blocks away (a block higher or lower is fine). Missing pedestals glow as ghosts until the circle is whole.

Then offer a §bCondensed Soul§r on the table.
codex.remnants.king.altar.title: Offering Table
codex.remnants.king.altar.text: Its heart is a Remnant Crown, taken from an Empowered or Crowned Remnant.
codex.remnants.king.pedestal.title: Soul Pedestal
codex.remnants.king.pedestal.text: Four are needed. In the second phase soul crystals rise above them.
codex.remnants.king.portrait.title: The Soul King
codex.remnants.king.portrait.text: Three heads. Four arms. Every soul you ever lost.
codex.remnants.king.2.title: Regicide
codex.remnants.king.2.text:
§6300§r health and three heads that can be broken one by one. In the second phase §bsoul crystals§r over the pedestals halve the damage he takes - shatter them. In the third, the ground itself burns.

He leaves the §bArsenal§r, the §bSoul King's Heart§r and 8-12 fragments. Everyone in the fight earns §615§r Resonance.
codex.remnants.arsenal.1.title: Four Weapons, One Will
codex.remnants.arsenal.1.text:
§bShift + right-click§r switches form.

• §bSword§r: sweeps; right-click - Soul Slash.
• §bBow§r: endless, phantom arrows fly straight; a full draw fires three.
• §bTrident§r: hold and release - a spectral trident that calls lightning.
• §bMace§r: smash from above; right-click - Soul Leap.
codex.remnants.arsenal.2.title: Care of the Arsenal
codex.remnants.arsenal.2.text: 2500 durability, repaired with a Condensed Soul on an anvil. The Soul Forge raises it like any weapon, and Spectral weapons hit Remnants harder: +15% per level.
codex.remnants.path.title: Path of the Soul
codex.remnants.path.1.title: Soul Resonance
codex.remnants.path.1.text:
Every soul you lay to rest leaves an echo in you.

• Your own Remnant: §63§r, +1 per death in its streak (up to +4), +3 if Empowered.
• Another player's Remnant: §62§r.
• A Forgotten Remnant: §61§r (Crowned: §63§r).
• The Soul King: §615§r for everyone in the fight.

Ranks at §65, 15, 30, 50 and 80§r. Each rank grants a permanent gift.
codex.remnants.path.2.title: The Five Gifts
codex.remnants.path.2.text:
I. §bVengeance§r: respawn with Regeneration, Speed and Strength while a Remnant waits.
II. §bSoul Bond§r: +20% damage to your Remnants, -15% from them.
III. §bFaithful Blade§r: your weapon in hand stays with you.
IV. §bLast Breath§r: once a day, survive a killing blow.
V. §bUndying Memory§r: your worn armor stays with you.
codex.remnants.chapter.death.desc: Your echo, your gear, your levels
codex.remnants.death.echo.title: An Echo as Strong as You
codex.remnants.death.echo.text:
A Remnant is exactly as strong as you were when you fell. It weighs your armor, your weapon and their enchantments:

• §bFaint Echo§r - little or no gear: about a player's health, plain strikes, no tricks.
• §bEcho§r - an iron kit: a couple of moves of its weapon, one rage phase.
• §bStrong Echo§r - diamond: more moves, three phases.
• §bGreat Echo§r - enchanted netherite: everything in this book.
codex.remnants.death.echo.tip: Died with a wooden sword? Its echo fights with one too. Died in netherite? Bring your best.
codex.remnants.battle.riposte: A glowing stance is a riposte: hit it and it strikes back from behind you. Wait - when it ends, it stands open.

codex.remnants.graves.1.title: The Unmarked Dead
codex.remnants.graves.1.text:
Adventurers died here long before you, and some were buried where they fell. A §bForgotten Grave§r lies two blocks under the surface, in earth that looks and sounds like any other - dirt, sand or gravel.

About one grave in three still has a §bweathered gravestone§r above it, often leaning, sometimes with old candles. The rest you will only find with a §bSoul Dowser§r.
codex.remnants.graves.dowser.title: Soul Dowser
codex.remnants.graves.dowser.text: Hold it in either hand. Within §616§r blocks of a grave it starts to §bclick§r - once a second at the edge, faster as you close in, in §btriple clicks§r within five blocks. Standing right above the grave, it §bchimes§r and the rod dips.
codex.remnants.graves.dowser.tip: Walk in a straight line and listen: when the clicks start slowing down, you have passed it.
codex.remnants.graves.dig.title: Digging Up the Dead
codex.remnants.graves.dig.text:
Dig the grave block and a §bBurial Casket§r climbs out of the hole. Open it: the dead adventurer's belongings spill out - worn gear, bones, nuggets, usually §bSoul Fragments§r, rarely a Condensed Soul, an enchanted book or even a Remnant Crown. Often there is also their §bEpitaph§r.

An opened casket stays: it is a fine piece of furniture, and can also be crafted.
codex.remnants.graves.dig.warn: One grave in five does not like being disturbed: its owner climbs out of the earth beside you.
codex.remnants.graves.epitaph.title: Epitaphs
codex.remnants.graves.epitaph.text:
An §bEpitaph§r remembers one death: who fell, how, where, on which day, how many levels they carried and how strong an echo they left.

Every death of yours is written into your §bChronicle§r (its own chapter). The epitaphs found in graves belong to people nobody remembers: §bright-click§r one to inscribe it there too.
codex.remnants.graves.epitaph.lore: Keep them. One day there will be a wall for every name.
codex.remnants.graves.lands.title: Echoes of Every Land
codex.remnants.graves.lands.text: The Forgotten take on the land they rise in - and one trick of it. They also climb out of the ground now: they cannot be hurt until they are out.
codex.remnants.graves.lands2.title: Drowned, Frozen, Sandy
codex.remnants.graves.lands2.text:
• §bDrowned§r (shores and rivers): hurls a §bchain harpoon§r that drags you in - break line of sight before it bites. Quick in water. Leaves a §bWet Shroud§r.
• §bFrozen§r (snow and ice): an §bice crust§r takes 30% off every blow until fire, an axe or a Fire Aspect blade cracks it; breathes a §bfreezing cone§r. Leaves §bSoul Frost§r.
• §bSandy§r (deserts, badlands): §bburrows§r, a trail of sand races under you, and it climbs out behind your back - turn around. Leaves a §bScarab Seal§r.
codex.remnants.graves.chakram.title: Bone Chakram
codex.remnants.graves.chakram.text: Right-click to throw. It flies about §615§r blocks and comes back to your hand, slicing every creature in its path (§65§r damage, Sharpness and Fire Aspect apply). On the way out it §bcuts grass and cobwebs§r, §bpresses buttons§r, pulls levers and rings bells; on the way back it §bgathers the items§r it passes.
codex.remnants.graves.inlay.title: Inlays
codex.remnants.graves.inlay.text:
Put the chakram and one biome trophy anywhere in a crafting grid:

• §bSoul Frost§r: hits slow and freeze.
• §bWet Shroud§r: hits drag the target toward you.
• §bScarab Seal§r: the first hit ricochets into a second target.

A new inlay replaces the old one.
codex.remnants.chronicle.intro: Every death of yours is written here: who, how, where and when, how many levels you carried and what echo you left. §bEpitaphs§r found in graves can be inscribed too: right-click one. The newest §6%s§r entries are kept.
codex.remnants.chronicle.empty: Not a single death yet. Long may it stay so.

advancements.remnants.reflection.descrip: Move an enchantment in the Reflecting Pool
advancements.remnants.master_smith.title: Forged by a Master
advancements.remnants.master_smith.descr: Five perfect strikes in the Soul Crucible
advancements.remnants.ghost_step.title: Ghost Step
advancements.remnants.ghost_step.descrip: Live through a killing blow in the Mourner's set
codex.remnants.craft.hammer.title: Ritual Hammer
codex.remnants.craft.hammer.text: Strike a structure's §bheart§r to lock it, or to see what is missing. In the Soul Crucible it keeps the §brhythm§r of the forging. §bShift + right-click§r turns the mod's blocks. It only wears down when it forges.
codex.remnants.craft.structures.title: Building a structure
codex.remnants.craft.structures.text: Place the blocks as the schematic shows and strike the heart. Anything missing shows as a §bhologram§r, layer by layer, for ten seconds. When everything is there, a wave of soul light runs over the blocks and the structure §blocks§r: light comes on in its seams. Break any block and it unlocks - a craft under way stops, and everything inside drops out whole.
codex.remnants.craft.structures.tip: Your own blocks - bellows, hearth, trough - can face any way: they turn themselves when the structure locks. Shift + right-click with anything in hand during a craft stops it and hands the ingredients back.
codex.remnants.craft.pool.title: Reflecting Pool
codex.remnants.craft.pool.schematic: 5 × 5: a ring of chiseled soul bricks, soul braziers at the corners, water sources inside, the basin in the middle.
codex.remnants.craft.pool.text:
Moves §bone enchantment of your choice§r - no lottery. Right-click the basin with the source item: it floats on the water. Then the target: it rests in the basin. With the Ritual Hammer in hand, looking at the pool, turn the §bmouse wheel§r: a label over the water shows the chosen enchantment and its price. Strike the basin to confirm.

Price: §63 experience levels and 1 Soul Fragment§r per level moved; treasure enchantments (Mending, Frost Walker...) cost §6twice as much§r. Compatibility and maximum levels work as on the anvil: equal levels combine, never past the maximum. An empty hand takes the items back.
codex.remnants.craft.pool.tip: Book to book splits one enchanted book into several: the source is the enchanted book, the target a plain book.
codex.remnants.craft.pool.warn: Curses never move. The price is paid only at the rite's last moment - stop it or break the pool before that and you keep everything.
codex.remnants.craft.basin.title: Reflecting Basin
codex.remnants.craft.crucible.title: Soul Crucible
codex.remnants.craft.crucible.schematic: 3 × 3 × 3, front towards you: below, the quench cauldron and the anvil in front; bellows - hearth - brick in the middle; a brick wall at the back. The crucible (the heart) on the hearth, the trough beside it over the anvil, a chimney two high behind.
codex.remnants.craft.crucible.text: The forge, again - with a rhythm. Right-click the crucible with a weapon, armour piece or tool to lay it on the anvil; Condensed Souls, the King's Heart and biome trophies go into the pot (it takes only what a recipe needs). Strike the crucible to begin: the souls melt, the pot tips, the melt runs down the trough onto the workpiece...
codex.remnants.craft.rhythm.title: The rhythm
codex.remnants.craft.rhythm.text:
...and the forging starts: §b5 strikes§r. A glowing mark runs over the anvil - strike (any block of the forge) as it crosses the middle. Within 3 ticks is §6perfect§r, within 6 good. The server times every strike itself and forgives up to 4 ticks of network lag.

§b3 good strikes§r of 5 give quality §6+5%§r, §b4§r §6+10%§r, §b5 perfect§r §6+15%§r and the mark "Forged by a master: your name". A good strike counts half. Quality gives weapons damage, armour protection, tools mining speed and everything durability. Then the quench: a cloud of steam, and the piece floats up out of the cauldron - take it with an empty hand.
codex.remnants.craft.rhythm.tip: One smith per forge. Reforging can make the quality worse, too - strike true.
codex.remnants.craft.recipes.title: What the Crucible forges
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.spectral: Spectral II weapon → §bIII§r. The third Spectral level is forged only here now; the Soul Forge gives I and II.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.awaken: §bAwakening (IV)§r, the Soul King's Arsenal only: +2 melee damage, its specials 20% stronger, +1 to each of its enchantments.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.mourner_h: Mourner's Hood: an iron helmet, 2 Wet Shrouds, Soul Frost, a Scarab Seal and a Condensed Soul.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.mourner_r: Mourner's Robe: an iron chestplate, 4 Wet Shrouds, 2 Soul Frost, a Scarab Seal and a Condensed Soul.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.mourner_l: Mourner's Leggings: iron leggings, 3 Wet Shrouds, Soul Frost, a Scarab Seal and a Condensed Soul.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.mourner_b: Mourner's Boots: iron boots, a Wet Shroud, 2 Soul Frost, a Scarab Seal and a Condensed Soul.
codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.reforge: Reforging: any weapon, armour piece or tool and one Condensed Soul - fully repaired, with a new quality.
codex.remnants.craft.hearth.title: Soul Hearth
codex.remnants.craft.hearth.text: Under the crucible; soul fire burns in it once the forge is locked.
codex.remnants.craft.bellows.title: Soul Bellows
codex.remnants.craft.bellows.text: Beside the hearth; they pump while the forge works.
codex.remnants.craft.trough.title: Soul Trough
codex.remnants.craft.trough.text: Beside the crucible, its spout over the anvil.
codex.remnants.craft.chimney.title: Soul Chimney
codex.remnants.craft.chimney.text: Two blocks behind the crucible; the top one becomes the cap by itself.
codex.remnants.craft.mourner.title: The Mourner's set
codex.remnants.craft.mourner.text: Bone, violet shroud cloth, thin gold. Armour 17, toughness 1 - between iron and diamond. The §bfull set§r gives Ghost Step: a killing blow makes you a ghost for 2 s instead (invulnerable, monsters lose you, translucent) and leaves you on two hearts. Cooldown 10 minutes.
codex.remnants.craft.mourner.lore: A Totem of Undying goes first, then the Path of the Soul's Last Breath, and only then the set - never in the same tick as Last Breath.
item.remnants_of_the_past.hand_bell.tool: Ring: for 5 s everything hidden within 12 blocks shows
Keeners, sleeping mimics, buried graves; breaks a wail. Cooldown 20 s
item.remnants_of_the_past.soul_tether.to: Fires a chain of soul up to 24 blocks: a block pulls you to it
Small creatures are reeled in; Remnants lose an armour piece for 10 s
item.remnants_of_the_past.ossuary_key.to: Opens an Ossuary Gate (the whole gate at once)
The Crypt Warden carries one; the key stays in the lock
item.remnants_of_the_past.wardens_gauntl: In the off hand: +40%% melee damage to anyone not facing you
The Warden's own lesson - strike where the shield is not
item.remnants_of_the_past.mimic_tongue.t: Still sticky. Makes a fine hook for a Soul Tether
block.remnants_of_the_past.ossuary_urn.t: Breaks open and spills what it held (Silk Touch keeps it whole)
Opens with an Ossuary Key, or when every Crypt Eye near it is struck
All touching gate blocks rise together
block.remnants_of_the_past.crypt_eye.too: Watching. A projectile closes it: an arrow, a trident, a snowball, a chakram
Close every eye within 8 blocks of a gate and the gate rises
block.remnants_of_the_past.rest_stone.to: Heart of the Belfry (3 × 3 × 5): strike it with the Ritual Hammer
At night a Condensed Soul on it or on the bell calls the Night of Memory
Part of the Belfry: hangs in the middle, under the roof
Gold and bone. Its toll is heard by the dead
block.remnants_of_the_past.cracked_bell_: Right-click with a Condensed Soul (and 2 gold ingots) to recast it
message.remnants.gate.locked: Locked. An Ossuary Key would open it
message.remnants.gate.locked_eyes: Locked. The eyes on the walls are watching it - close them, or use a key
message.remnants.warden.guard: Its shield turns every blow from the front - get behind it, or wait for it to miss
message.remnants.belfry.unformed: Lock the belfry first: strike the Rest Stone with the Ritual Hammer
message.remnants.belfry.busy: The Night of Memory is already under way
message.remnants.belfry.no_night: There is no night here for the bell to call
message.remnants.belfry.day: The bell only calls the dead at night (before the small hours)
message.remnants.belfry.peaceful: On Peaceful no dead answer the bell
message.remnants.belfry.cooldown: The bell still rings in the ears of the dead: about %s min
message.remnants.belfry.hint: At night, ring it with a Condensed Soul to call the Night of Memory
message.remnants.belfry.cracked: Cracked through. A Condensed Soul and %s gold ingots would recast it
message.remnants.belfry.no_cancel: A Night of Memory cannot be called off
event.remnants.night.sub: The bell wakes the dead around it
event.remnants.night.wave.sub.1: They climb out of the earth
event.remnants.night.wave.sub.2: A crowned one walks among them
event.remnants.night.failed.dawn: Dawn came. The dead sink back into the earth
event.remnants.night.failed.forsaken: Nobody stood by the bell. The dead sink back into the earth
event.remnants.night.failed.broken: The belfry broke. The dead sink back into the earth
epitaph.remnants.hero.cause.0: held the bell against the night until dawn
epitaph.remnants.hero.cause.1: rang for the dead when no one else would
epitaph.remnants.hero.cause.2: fell at the foot of the belfry, the bell still ringing

codex.remnants.crypts.ossuary.title: The Ossuary
codex.remnants.crypts.ossuary.text:
A crypt under a half-sunken §bmausoleum§r of dark stone. A stair leads down to a hall with a pillar of bones; from there the passages branch: skull niches, burial niches with sealed caskets, ossuary chambers full of urns, stairs ever deeper. One way always leads to the §bCrypt Warden§r.

Break an urn and it spills what it held - bones, nuggets, now and then a Soul Fragment.
codex.remnants.crypts.ossuary.tip: Bring a light, a bow and something to dig with. Caskets in the walls open like the ones in Forgotten Graves - and so can their owners.
codex.remnants.crypts.gates.title: Gates and eyes
codex.remnants.crypts.gates.text: Vaults hide behind §bOssuary Gates§r. A gate does not break - it opens. Two ways: an §bOssuary Key§r (used on any of its bars; the key stays in the lock), or the §bCrypt Eyes§r of the room: set high in the walls, they glow while they watch. Strike each one with a §bprojectile§r - an arrow, a trident, a snowball, the Bone Chakram - and it closes. When every eye within §68§r blocks of the gate is shut, the gate rises. While a gate is shut, the walls, floor and ceiling of its vault are warded: no pick or blast gets through.
codex.remnants.crypts.gates.warn: The Warden's treasury has no eyes. Only its key opens it.
codex.remnants.crypts.warden.title: The Crypt Warden
codex.remnants.crypts.warden.text: A knight of stone on a plinth - until you come near. Its tower shield turns §cevery blow from the front§r. Damage only gets through §bfrom behind§r (§6+25%%§r) or while it is §bexposed§r: its greatsword stuck in the floor after a Crushing Blow that hit nothing, a stagger after a Sweep that missed, a daze after its Shield Charge met a wall. It turns slowly - circle it.
codex.remnants.crypts.warden.warn: Watch its wind-ups: the sword rises overhead (Crushing Blow, step aside), the body coils (Sweep, step back), it crouches behind the shield (Charge, put a wall behind you). Below half health it is quicker and follows a blow that lands with a Sweep.
codex.remnants.crypts.gauntlet.title: The Warden's spoils
codex.remnants.crypts.gauntlet.text: It drops the §bOssuary Key§r to its treasury and the §bWarden's Gauntlet§r: in the off hand, every melee blow at someone who is not facing you deals §6+40%%§r. Its own lesson. Left alone for a while, a Warden walks back to its plinth and turns to stone again, whole.
codex.remnants.crypts.mimic.title: The Grave Mimic
codex.remnants.crypts.mimic.text: Some urns are hungry. A sleeping mimic is the urn to the last speck of glaze - but now and then its §blid breathes§r, a Soul Dowser §btwitches§r near it, and a Hand Bell makes it §bflinch§r. Come within a couple of blocks and it wakes: it hops after you, bites, leaps on you and holds on (hit it to break free), spits bones from afar. It drops its §btongue§r.
codex.remnants.crypts.bell.title: Hand Bell
codex.remnants.crypts.bell.text: One clear ring shows what hides within §612§r blocks for §65 s§r: monsters and the invisible glow, a Keener shows and its wail breaks off, sleeping mimics flinch, buried graves breathe soul light. Cooldown §620 s§r.
codex.remnants.crypts.tether.title: Soul Tether
codex.remnants.crypts.tether.text: A chain of soul with a mimic's tongue for a hook, §624§r blocks. Into a block - it reels you to it (falls are forgiven; sneak or use it again to let go). Into a small creature - it reels the creature in; into anything big, or a boss - you to it. Into a §bRemnant§r - it tears one armour piece off for §610 s§r. Cooldown §63 s§r.
codex.remnants.crypts.belfry.title: The Belfry
codex.remnants.crypts.belfry.schematic: 3 × 3 × 5: the Rest Stone in the middle of the ground layer, soul braziers on its four sides, soul bricks at the corners; a post at each corner three high (wooden fence, log or soul brick wall); the Bell of Rest hanging in the middle of the third layer; a roof of nine wooden slabs.
codex.remnants.crypts.belfry.text: Build it, strike the §bRest Stone§r with the Ritual Hammer, and wait for the night. A §bCondensed Soul§r rung against the bell (or laid on the stone) calls the §bNight of Memory§r.
codex.remnants.crypts.rest_stone.title: Rest Stone
codex.remnants.crypts.bell_of_rest.title: Bell of Rest
codex.remnants.crypts.bell_of_rest.text: Hangs under the roof; it swings with every wave.
codex.remnants.crypts.night.title: Night of Memory
codex.remnants.crypts.night.text:
Three waves of Forgotten climb out of the ground §68 to 24§r blocks round the tower: §64, 6 and 8§r of them (§6+2§r for every extra player). The second wave brings a §bCrowned§r one, the third a §bKeener§r. Ten seconds of respite between the waves.

Stand them all: §66-10§r Soul Fragments, a chance of a Remnant Crown, the Epitaph of a hero, and §6+4§r Path of the Soul for everyone who stood the night. One night per bell per game day.
codex.remnants.crypts.night.warn: Dawn ends it, and so does leaving: with nobody within 48 blocks of the bell for 30 s the dead sink back into the earth, and the soul is spent.
codex.remnants.crypts.keener.title: The Keener
codex.remnants.crypts.keener.text: A ghost in a torn shroud, all but invisible - a shimmer and dripping soul light. A hit, a §bHand Bell§r or a look through a §bspyglass§r shows it for 5 s. Its §bWail§r (3 s) heals the Forgotten and makes them stronger: break it with a single hit of §66+§r or a bell. Its §bScream§r throws you back and darkens your sight.
codex.remnants.crypts.ruin.title: The Ruined Belfry
codex.remnants.crypts.ruin.text: On hills and plains stand old belfries gone to ruin: braziers fallen, posts broken, the roof half gone, the bell §bcracked§r. A Condensed Soul and two gold ingots recast the bell; set back what is missing (strike the stone - the hologram shows it), and the belfry is yours.
item.remnants_of_the_past.archivist_quil: Main hand; an enchanted item in the off hand; a book in the bag: right-click
Writes the item's enchantments onto a book, the item keeps them. Once a day
Blunt - sharpen it on an anvil with a Condensed Soul
item.remnants_of_the_past.seal_of_memory: In the Soul Crucible: a weapon, armour or tool + the Seal + a Condensed Soul
makes it Remembered: it stays with you when you die
item.remnants_of_the_past.remembered: ✦ Remembered: stays with you when you die
Hold right-click while falling to glide; dive to go faster
Warm air over campfires, soul braziers and hearths carries you up
item.remnants_of_the_past.soul_lantern_t: Right-click a monster worn down to a quarter of its health: it is caught
Set free, it fights for you for a minute and fades. Not bosses, not Remnants
Right-click a block to set it free as your ally
item.remnants_of_the_past.decoy_echo.too: Throw it: your ghostly copy stands where it lands for 8 s
Monsters around - and your own Remnants - turn on it
block.remnants_of_the_past.memorial_proj: Heart of the Memorial: a wall of 15 Epitaph Niches two blocks behind it
Right-click with an empty hand: watch your last 10 seconds before death
block.remnants_of_the_past.epitaph_niche: Right-click with an Epitaph to set it in, with an empty hand to chisel your Chronicle
Sneak + empty hand takes the tablet out
block.remnants_of_the_past.soul_astrolab: Heart of the Astrolabe: on chiseled soul bricks, four obelisks round it
A focus on the sphere - a Soul Compass, a map, an Epitaph - and a Soul Fragment: it finds
block.remnants_of_the_past.focus_crystal: Tops each of the Astrolabe's four obelisks
resonance.remnants.branch.reaper.desc: +15%% melee damage to Remnants and the undead. Every blow on a Remnant heals you for 15%% of the damage dealt.
resonance.remnants.branch.keeper.desc: A shield sends 25%% of what it blocks back at the attacker and shoves it off. An ally from the Soul Lantern fights twice as long; your Decoy stands half as long again.
resonance.remnants.branch.wanderer.desc: The Soul Tether reaches 32 blocks and recharges twice as fast. The Shroud Glider flies a quarter faster and rides the updrafts higher. The anchor network carries you for free.
message.remnants.branch.rank: A branch of the Path opens at rank %s
message.remnants.branch.heart: Changing your branch takes a Soul King's Heart
message.remnants.branch.chosen: ✦ You walk the Path as the %s
message.remnants.branch.changed: ✦ The Heart burns away. You walk the Path as the %s now
message.remnants.quill.how: Hold an enchanted item in your off hand and a book in your bag
message.remnants.quill.blunt: The quill is blunt. An anvil and a Condensed Soul will sharpen it
message.remnants.quill.book: The quill will not copy a book - only the enchantments on a thing
message.remnants.quill.nothing: Nothing to write: no enchantments (curses are never copied)
message.remnants.quill.dry: The ink is still drying: about %s min
message.remnants.quill.no_book: You need a blank book to write in
message.remnants.lantern.full: The lantern already holds a soul
message.remnants.lantern.healthy: %s is too strong yet - wear it down to a quarter of its health
message.remnants.anchor.attuned: ✦ Anchor added to your network (%s / %s). Rename it with a Name Tag
message.remnants.anchor.network_full: Your network holds %s anchors - no room for more
message.remnants.anchor.stand: Stand by one of your anchors to travel the network
message.remnants.anchor.gone: That anchor is gone - it has left your network
message.remnants.anchor.cooldown: The anchors are still settling: %s s
message.remnants.anchor.cancelled: You stepped away - the jump is off (the soul is given back)
screen.remnants.anchors.free: Jumps are free for a Wanderer
screen.remnants.anchors.hint: Click an anchor to go there
screen.remnants.anchors.lonely: Touch more anchors to join them to the network
message.remnants.niche.full: There is already a tablet in this niche
message.remnants.niche.twice: This epitaph is on the wall already
message.remnants.niche.no_chronicle: Your Chronicle is empty - there is nothing of yours to chisel
message.remnants.niche.all_on_wall: Every entry of your Chronicle is on this wall already
message.remnants.memorial.unformed: Lock the Memorial first: strike the projector with the Ritual Hammer
message.remnants.memorial.busy: The projector is playing a memory
message.remnants.memorial.no_record: No record of your last death yet
message.remnants.memorial.full: ✦ The wall is full. Your Path of the Soul gains +%s%%
message.remnants.astrolabe.no_focus: Set a focus on the sphere: a Soul Compass, a map or an Epitaph
message.remnants.astrolabe.cost: A search costs a Soul Fragment
message.remnants.archivist.barrier: A barrier of runes turns every blow - shoot the Eyes on the walls
event.remnants.archivist.eyes.sub: Shut the Eyes on the walls - with arrows
event.remnants.archivist.stars.sub: Watch the floor: the stars are falling
book.remnants.archive.1:
I keep what the dead forget.

Every name that fell, every last word, every road that ended in the dark - written here, page after page, that nothing be lost.
book.remnants.archive.2:
The King thought a crown would keep him. The Warden thought a gate would. They are in my book now, like everyone.

Memory outlasts stone.
book.remnants.archive.3:
Some come to read. Some come to take. The pages know the difference, and so do my eyes on the walls.

Close them, if you can.
book.remnants.archive.4:
If you are reading this, I have closed my book at last.

Take the quill. Write kindly of those who fell.

advancements.remnants.star_path.descript: Let a Soul Astrolabe point the way
advancements.remnants.crossroads.title: Crossroads

advancements.remnants.lantern_ally.descr: Set a caught monster free to fight for you

codex.remnants.crucible_recipe.remember: Remembrance: any weapon, armour or tool with a Seal of Memory and a Condensed Soul - it becomes Remembered and stays with you when you die.
codex.remnants.archive.library.title: The Library
codex.remnants.archive.library.text: One Ossuary in four was dug deeper. Its hall of bones does not lead to a Warden but to the §bLibrary§r: a vault of shelves on two floors, a gallery, chandeliers of soul fire - and at the lectern, reading, the §bArchivist§r. Behind it the Archive's treasury waits behind a gate that rises only when the Archivist falls.
codex.remnants.archive.library.tip: A Soul Astrolabe with a map on it finds Ossuaries no map shows yet - the Library among them.
codex.remnants.archive.archivist.title: The Archivist
codex.remnants.archive.archivist.text: Keeper of every memory, §6400§r health, three phases. It floats over its lectern reading until you come close, keeps §66-12§r blocks off and does not like company: stand next to it and it leafs away, or throws you back with a burst of pages.
codex.remnants.archive.tomes.title: Phase 1: Tomes
codex.remnants.archive.tomes.text: It throws §bflying tomes§r that come back to it like boomerangs - they hit on the way out and on the way back (§67§r). From its book tear §bPages§r: little fluttering things that dart in for paper cuts. Fire burns them twice as fast.
codex.remnants.archive.eyes.title: Phase 2: Eyes
codex.remnants.archive.eyes.text: At two thirds of its health it rises behind a §bbarrier of runes§r - §cno blow gets through§r. Four §bEyes of the Archive§r open high on the walls. Shut each with a §bprojectile§r: an arrow, a trident, a snowball, the Bone Chakram. Every eye breaks an arc of the barrier and drops the Archivist to the floor for three seconds - strike then (§6+25%%§r).
codex.remnants.archive.eyes.warn: Bring a bow. In this phase it cannot be killed - only the eyes end it.
codex.remnants.archive.stars.title: Phase 3: Constellation
codex.remnants.archive.stars.text: With the barrier gone it fights in earnest: §bspirals of runes§r stream off its fingers, and §bstars§r fall at your feet - two seconds of light, then a burst (§68§r). Keep moving. Near the end it hurries.
codex.remnants.archive.spoils.title: Its spoils
codex.remnants.archive.spoils.text: The §bArchivist's Quill§r, the §bSeal of Memory§r, §68-12§r Soul Fragments, two Condensed Souls, enchanted books, and §6+12§r Path of the Soul for everyone who stood in the fight. The treasury gate rises.
codex.remnants.archive.quill.title: The Archivist's Quill
codex.remnants.archive.quill.text: The quill in the main hand, an enchanted item in the other, a blank book in your bag: right-click - the item's enchantments are written onto a new enchanted book, and the item §bkeeps its own§r. Curses are never copied. Once a game day per quill.
codex.remnants.archive.quill.warn: Four writings and it is §bblunt§r: an anvil and a Condensed Soul sharpen it, a point at a time. It will not copy an enchanted book.
codex.remnants.archive.seal.title: The Seal of Memory
codex.remnants.archive.seal.text: In the Soul Crucible: a weapon, an armour piece or a tool on the anvil, the Seal and a Condensed Soul in the pot. The forged item is §bRemembered§r - it crosses over with you when you die, like the Codex.
codex.remnants.archive.memorial.title: The Memorial
codex.remnants.archive.memorial.schemati: The Memorial Projector, and two blocks behind it a wall 5 wide and 3 high of Epitaph Niches, turned toward it (15 in all).
codex.remnants.archive.memorial.text: Build it, strike the projector with the Ritual Hammer. A §bniche§r takes an Epitaph (right-click with it); with an empty hand it chisels the newest entry of your §bChronicle§r that is not on this wall yet. The letters appear one by one. Sneak with an empty hand to take a tablet out. A §bfull wall§r of fifteen gives whoever locked the Memorial §6+10%%§r on the Path of the Soul.
codex.remnants.archive.projector.title: Memorial Projector
codex.remnants.archive.niche.title: Epitaph Niche
codex.remnants.archive.niche.text: Four at a time from soul bricks and a candle.
codex.remnants.archive.record.title: The last record
codex.remnants.archive.record.text: The dead remember their last moments. The last §610§r seconds before every death are kept - where you stood, where you looked, what you held, what came for you. Right-click a locked projector with an empty hand: your ghost gathers out of soul light and lives them again, and whatever killed you walks beside it, glowing. Everyone near sees it.
codex.remnants.archive.record.lore: Now you know where the creeper came from.
codex.remnants.archive.astrolabe.title: The Soul Astrolabe
codex.remnants.archive.astrolabe.schemat: 3 x 3 x 3: the Astrolabe on a block of chiseled soul bricks; at each corner an obelisk of soul bricks, a soul brick wall and a Focus Crystal on top.
codex.remnants.archive.astrolabe.text: Lock it with the Hammer. Set a §bfocus§r on the sphere and right-click with an empty hand - a search costs a Soul Fragment. The rings spin and lock in line, and a beam points the way for a minute, the distance floating above. A §bSoul Compass§r finds your nearest Remnant (in another world it names the place); a §bmap§r - the nearest Ossuary or Library no map shows yet; an §bEpitaph§r - the place of that death.
codex.remnants.archive.sphere.title: Soul Astrolabe
codex.remnants.archive.sphere.text: The heart: bronze, gold and a compass.
codex.remnants.archive.crystal.title: Focus Crystal
codex.remnants.archive.crystal.text: Two at a time; four are needed.
codex.remnants.archive.anchors.title: The anchor network
codex.remnants.archive.anchors.text: Every Soul Anchor you touch joins your §bnetwork§r (up to §616§r). A renamed anchor (an anvil, or a Name Tag on the block) is listed by its name. Sneak and right-click one of yours with an empty hand: the Anchors screen. Pick another anchor in this world - you come apart into soul light for a second (stepping away calls it off) and gather on top of it. A jump costs §61§r Soul Fragment, free for a Wanderer.
codex.remnants.archive.glider.title: Shroud Glider
codex.remnants.archive.glider.text: Hold right-click while falling: you sink slowly and drift the way you look; look down to dive faster. No fall damage while it is open. Over a lit §bcampfire§r, a §bsoul brazier§r or a §bSoul Hearth§r the warm air carries you up - build your own updrafts.
codex.remnants.archive.lantern.title: Soul Lantern
codex.remnants.archive.lantern.text: Wear a monster down to a §6quarter§r of its health and right-click it: caught. The lantern glows in its colour. Right-click a block to set it free - for §660 s§r it fights for you, never touches a player, and fades without a drop. Bosses and Remnants cannot be caught.
codex.remnants.archive.decoy.title: Decoy Echo
codex.remnants.archive.decoy.text: Throw it. Where it lands your ghostly copy stands for §68 s§r holding what you held, and the monsters around - your own Remnants too - go for it instead of you.
codex.remnants.path.branches.text: At rank §6%s§r the Path forks. Choose one branch - the first choice is free; changing it later costs a §bSoul King's Heart§r.
codex.remnants.path.memorial: A full Memorial wall of yours adds +10%% to every gain on the Path.
advancements.remnants.murder_of_crows.de: Shoot down a Carrion Crow and take back what it stole
codex.remnants.death.crows.title: Carrion Crows
codex.remnants.death.crows.text: Leave a Remnant waiting longer than §610 minutes§r and the crows find it: three to five bony birds circle over it. Every few minutes one dives and carries off a stack of its §bsupplies§r - never its gear - to the nearest tree, and sits there with it. Shoot it down and the stack falls. While you were away the crows did not wait: come back late and some are already on the branches round about.
codex.remnants.death.crows.tip: Crows only come under an open sky. When you come back, the empty-handed ones fly off; the ones holding your things stay - look up into the trees.
message.remnants.treasury_warded: The vault is warded while its gate is shut - open the gate
